bus_backend: STM32CubeF1 HAL I2C DMA with threadx completion handling

device_addressing.selection_rule: SDO/address-select pin changes the 7-bit I2C address.

dma_requirements.backend: STM32CubeF1 HAL I2C DMA with threadx completion handling
configuration_requirements: Enable the existing STM32F1 HAL DMA and selected bus modules.
Configure the original controller's DMA1 TX/RX channels, link handles, and install DMA/peripheral IRQ handlers.
Use HAL completion/error callbacks and an RTOS-compatible completion wait.
Retain the original board-supplied operation interface and its context; bind its transfer implementation to the supplied STM32CubeF1 DMA backend.
generation_requirements: Keep the original board, MCU, bus instance, wiring, address/chip select, and device protocol.
Use the selected existing RTOS/BSP/HAL DMA backend for the core payload.
Keep transfer buffers allocated, accessible, and unchanged until the API's completion condition.
Apply the controller's end-of-transfer rules before consuming receive data or releasing chip select.
Report transfer submission errors, DMA/peripheral errors, and bounded-wait timeouts.
Finish or abort an outstanding transfer before buffer reuse or a subsequent operation.
Preserve device conversion delays, programming waits, command ordering, and numerical semantics.
Use DMA for calibration coefficients and measurement registers.
device_scenarios: Preserve multibyte assembly and sign extension.
Apply compensation only after all required bytes arrive.

validation_requirements.requirement: Observe DMA submission, direction, payload length, and completion for the core data transfer.
Consume receive data and reuse buffers only after the required completion event.
Return the specified error and release transfer state after failure or timeout.
Support a subsequent operation after successful completion or completed error cleanup.
